packages.label: סוּרָא וְהָעַכּוּ"ם
packages.label_en: Sura and the Nations — The Side of Idolatry
packages.reason: These two nodes share the essential nature of the forces of deviation from God — the nations (עכו"ם) in their aspect of idolatry and separation. The Rebbe explicitly states: 'סוּרָא זֶה בְּחִינַת עַכּוּ"ם, עַל שֵׁם עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: סָרוּ מַהֵר מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ' — the place-name Sura IS the nations, named from the root סור (to deviate). Both express the same essential quality: the reality of idolatry as radical departure from the path. The context in Torah #16 makes this evil identification structurally important: the two rivers of Sura represent the two Messianic streams that will eventually draw the nations back — indicating that Sura/the nations are the very audience that must be redeemed. This is the only bechina edge present in the dataset for this Torah.
merge_notes: Raw component: {סורא, עכו"ם} — 2 nodes, 1 edge (dataset id 2388).

No merges possible: this is the only bechina-connected component in the Torah #16 dataset. The teaching contains a rich structure of additional bechinas not yet in the dataset (see torah_16_additions.json and torah_16_new_packages.json). Until those are added, this 2-node evil package stands alone.

This package would naturally expand to include: עֵשָׂו וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל (the two nations explicitly listed as comprising the עכו"ם of Sura), and תְּרֵין עֲנָנִין (the two clouds = Esav and Yishmael covering the Tzadik's eyes). Those additions are proposed in torah_16_additions.json.

stats.dataset_coverage_note: Torah #16 is severely under-represented in the dataset. The source text contains at least 9 additional bechina equations with explicit bechina-language (בְּחִינַת, הַיְנוּ, מְכֻנִּים, אִנּוּן). These are enumerated in torah_16_additions.json and would support 3 substantive packages if added.
